title: Claims
description: Tracked (corpus/claims.json): the claims the documents make, each naming the surfaces whose axes it takes. The prober refuses a file that does not match this schema when it reads one (decision 102).

schemaVersion.description: The schema version. A file or line without it is version 1 (the Python baseline).

source.description: file#heading of the document that states it

narrow.description: axis dropped, with the source sentence that limits it (checked verbatim)

exclude.description: pairs no row can hold, each group with the reason why; `prober universe` prints the reasons, since nothing checks them mechanically

reason.description: one sentence saying why the pairs cannot exist or are not promised, citing a docs sentence, a record or a KB fact where one applies
